steps.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
steps.text: Well seeing as you asked nicely... I could do with some help.

steps.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
steps.text: The wizard Grayzag next door decided he didn't like me so he enlisted an army of hundreds of imps.

steps.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
steps.text: These imps stole all sorts of my things. Most of these things I don't really care about, just eggs and balls of string and things.

steps.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
steps.text: But they stole my four magical beads. There was a red one, a yellow one, a black one, and a white one.

steps.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
steps.text: These imps have now spread out all over the kingdom. Could you get my beads back for me?
If the player already has all four beads in their inventory:

steps.player: Well this is a surprising turn of events!
Well I just so happen to have all of those beads on me!

steps.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
steps.text: Are you saying that you stole my beads all this time and I've been blaming these imps!?

steps.player: No, not at all! I just found them throughout my travels and presumed somebody would need them at some point.

steps.text: If the player does not have all four beads in their inventory:

steps.player: I've better things to do than chase imps.

steps.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
steps.text: Well if you're not interested in the quests I have to give you, don't waste my time by asking me for them.

options.text: Give me a quest or else!

steps.player: Give me a quest or else!

steps.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
steps.text: Or else what? You'll attack me?

options.text: Just stop messing around and give me a quest!

steps.player: Just stop messing around and give me a quest!

steps.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
steps.text: Ah now you're assuming I have one to give.

finding-the-beads-speaking-to-wizard-miz.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
finding-the-beads-speaking-to-wizard-miz.text: So how are you doing finding my beads?

finding-the-beads-speaking-to-wizard-miz.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
finding-the-beads-speaking-to-wizard-miz.text: Well get on with it. I've lost a white bead, a red bead, a black bead, and a yellow bead. Go kill some imps!

finding-the-beads-speaking-to-wizard-miz.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
finding-the-beads-speaking-to-wizard-miz.text: So how are you doing finding my beads?

finding-the-beads-speaking-to-wizard-miz.player: I have found some of your beads.

finding-the-beads-speaking-to-wizard-miz.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
finding-the-beads-speaking-to-wizard-miz.text: Come back when you have them all. The colour of the four beads that I need are red, yellow, black, and white. Go chase some imps!

finding-the-beads-speaking-to-wizard-gra.speaker: Wizard Grayzag
finding-the-beads-speaking-to-wizard-gra.text: You're a fool, [player name]. Do you really think you'll find four imps out of thousands? Good luck. Ha!

finishing-up-giving-the-beads-to-wizard-.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
finishing-up-giving-the-beads-to-wizard-.text: So how are you doing finding my beads?

finishing-up-giving-the-beads-to-wizard-.player: I've got all four beads. It was hard work I can tell you.

finishing-up-quest-complete.speaker: Wizard Mizgog
finishing-up-quest-complete.text: Give them here and I'll check that they really are MY beads, before I give you your reward. You'll like it, it's an amulet of accuracy.
You give four coloured beads to Wizard Mizgog.
Wizard Mizgog places the four beads on the table and casts a spell on them.
The wizard hands you an amulet.
